+    # Debian policy only allows exact version relationships in Provides.
+    # See https://www.debian.org/doc/debian-policy/ch-relationships.html
+    if !(m = provides.match(/\A([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*)(?:\s+\(=\s*([^)]+)\))?\z/))
+      raise FPM::InvalidPackageConfiguration,
+        "Invalid 'provides' entry '#{provides}'. Expected 'name' or 'name (= version)'."
+    end

+      raise FPM::InvalidPackageConfiguration,
+        "Invalid version in 'provides' entry '#{provides}'. " \
+        "Debian version strings must start with a digit."
+    end
+
+    return provides
   end
